name: stophy-sdk
description: Live web data as typed JSON for AI agents. Search, video, social, jobs, places, property and ads behind one key, with a flat price per call. You pay only for answers that come back.

scripts.build: bun run build:ts && bun run build:py
scripts.generate:py: uv run --project packages/python python scripts/gen_python.py && uv run --project packages/python ruff format packages/python/src/stophy/generated
scripts.generate: bun run generate:ts && bun run generate:py
scripts.generate:check: bun run generate:ts && git diff --exit-code -- packages/typescript/src/generated
scripts.check:py: uv run --project packages/python ruff check packages/python/src test/python && uv run --project packages/python ruff format --check packages/python/src test/python
scripts.check: bun run check:ts && bun run type-check && bun run check:py && bun run type-check:py
scripts.format:py: uv run --project packages/python ruff check --fix packages/python/src test/python && uv run --project packages/python ruff format packages/python/src test/python
scripts.format: bun run format:ts && bun run format:py
scripts.test: bun run test:ts && bun run test:py
